functionDeclarations.name: manage_subagents
functionDeclarations.description:
Manage existing subagents.
	Actions:
	* 'list': List all active subagents and their conversation IDs.
	* 'kill': Terminate specific subagents and all their descendants.
	* 'kill_all': Terminate all subagents and all their descendants.

	When a subagent is killed, its branched workspaces will be deleted, but its logs and artifacts will be preserved.

Action.description: The action to perform. Must be 'list' (list all active subagents), 'kill' (terminate specific subagents and all their descendants), or 'kill_all' (terminate all subagents and all their descendants).

ConversationIds.description: The IDs of the subagents to kill. Required for 'kill'.
